$description: Follow-Through & Overlapping Action tokens - Disney principles for secondary motion and natural settling.

follow-through.$description: Parameters for motion that continues after primary action stops

tight.$description: Minimal follow-through. Professional, controlled. Enterprise UI.

loose.$description: Noticeable lag and overshoot. Consumer apps, friendly UI.

fluid.$description: Pronounced follow-through with multiple oscillations. Playful, organic.

heavy.$description: Slow, weighty follow-through. Heavy objects, dramatic emphasis.

elastic.$description: High overshoot, many oscillations. Rubber, jelly, bouncy materials.

overlap.$description: Stagger offsets for overlapping action between elements

$value.description: Small overlap - elements start while previous is 80% done

sequential.$description: Tight sequencing with minimal overlap. Ordered, methodical.

$value.description: Moderate overlap - elements start while previous is 60% done

staggered.$description: Standard stagger for list animations. Balanced flow.

$value.description: Large overlap - elements start while previous is 40% done

cascading.$description: Wave-like cascade. Multiple elements in motion simultaneously.

$value.description: Near-simultaneous - elements start while previous is 20% done

simultaneous.$description: Almost all elements moving at once. Explosive, energetic.

secondary-elements.$description: Delay and behavior for secondary/child elements

attached-tight.$description: Closely attached items (badge on card). Minimal lag.

attached-loose.$description: Loosely connected items (pendant, charm). Noticeable drag.

independent.$description: Loosely related elements. Own physics, responds to primary.

spring-configs.$description: Spring physics configurations for natural settling

tight-spring.$description: Quick settle, minimal oscillation. Professional UI.

bouncy-spring.$description: Low damping, visible bounce. Playful UI.

heavy-spring.$description: Heavy mass, slow settle. Weighty elements.

wobbly-spring.$description: Very low damping. Jelly, rubber-like wobble.
